original_en: Starting at 25.0 seconds, apply a cool desaturated teal-gray color grade with soft contrast to the entire waterside scene.
original_zh: 从第 25.0 秒开始，为整个水边场景应用冷调、低饱和的青灰色调和柔和对比度。
atoms_en: Does the entire waterside scene receive a cool desaturated teal-gray color grade?
Does the graded scene have soft contrast?
atoms_zh: 整个水边场景是否呈现冷调、低饱和的青灰色调？
调色后的场景是否具有柔和对比度？

original_en: Starting at 27.0 seconds, transform the complete fallen-log waterside scene into a soft chalk-pastel landscape illustration over three seconds.
original_zh: 从第 27.0 秒开始，在三秒内将完整的倒木水边场景转换为柔和的粉笔彩绘风景插画。
atoms_en: Does the complete fallen-log waterside scene transform into a soft chalk-pastel landscape illustration?
Is the transformation completed within three seconds?
atoms_zh: 完整的倒木水边场景是否转换为柔和的粉笔彩绘风景插画？
这一转换是否在 3 秒内完成？

original_en: Starting at 18.0 seconds, move the camera forward faster along the stream until the visible rock cluster fills the foreground by 22.0 seconds.
original_zh: 从第 18.0 秒开始，让镜头沿溪流更快地向前移动，直到可见岩石群在第 22.0 秒前填满前景。
atoms_en: Does the camera move forward faster along the stream?
Does the visible rock cluster fill the foreground within four seconds?
atoms_zh: 镜头是否沿溪流更快地向前移动？
可见岩石群是否在 4 秒内填满前景？

original_en: At 28.0 seconds, place the smaller foreground rock one rock-width from the large round boulder across the streambed.
original_zh: 在第 28.0 秒，将较小的前景岩石放置在溪床另一侧，距大型圆形巨石一个岩石宽度。
atoms_en: Is the smaller foreground rock placed across the streambed from the large round boulder?
Is the separation one rock-width?
atoms_zh: 较小的前景岩石是否被放置在大型圆形巨石对面的溪床另一侧？
两块岩石的间距是否为一个岩石宽度？

original_en: Starting at 31.0 seconds, make the stream flow rapidly downstream with stronger visible eddies around the rocks for five seconds.
original_zh: 从第 31.0 秒开始，让溪水快速向下游流动五秒，并在岩石周围形成更强的可见涡流。
atoms_en: Does the stream flow rapidly downstream for five seconds?
Do stronger visible eddies form around the rocks during the same five seconds?
atoms_zh: 溪水是否快速向下游流动 5 秒？
岩石周围是否在同一段 5 秒内形成更强的可见涡流？

original_en: Starting at 14.0 seconds, convert the complete kelp corridor into restrained 1960s underwater film with fine grain over three seconds.
original_zh: 从第 14.0 秒开始，在三秒内将完整的海带通道转换为带细腻颗粒的克制 20 世纪 60 年代水下胶片影像。
atoms_en: Does the complete kelp corridor transform into restrained 1960s underwater film within 3 seconds?
Does fine grain appear within the same 3 seconds?
atoms_zh: 完整的海带通道是否在 3 秒内转换为克制的 20 世纪 60 年代水下胶片风格？
画面是否在同一段 3 秒内出现细腻颗粒？

original_en: At 29.0 seconds, move the nearest left kelp cluster one meter left of the sandy corridor edge.
original_zh: 在第 29.0 秒，将最近的左侧海带簇移至沙质通道边缘左侧一米处。
atoms_en: Is the nearest left kelp cluster moved to the left of the sandy corridor edge?
Does it end up one meter from the edge?
atoms_zh: 最近的左侧海带簇是否被移至沙质通道边缘左侧？
海带簇最终是否距该边缘 1 米？

original_en: Starting at 27.0 seconds, make the tall kelp fronds on both sides bend right and recover in synchronized waves for five seconds.
original_zh: 从第 27.0 秒开始，让两侧高大的海带叶片以同步波动向右弯曲并恢复，持续五秒。
atoms_en: Do the tall kelp fronds on both sides bend right and recover?
Are the waves synchronized between both sides?
Does the motion continue for five seconds?
atoms_zh: 两侧高大的海带叶片是否向右弯曲后恢复？
两侧的波动是否同步？
这一运动是否持续 5 秒？

original_en: Starting at 13.0 seconds, open the gray wall-mounted electrical-cabinet door outward to a stable forty-five-degree angle.
original_zh: 从第 13.0 秒开始，将灰色壁挂式电气柜门向外打开至稳定的四十五度。
atoms_en: Does the gray wall-mounted electrical-cabinet door open outward?
Does it reach and remain at a stable forty-five-degree angle?
atoms_zh: 灰色壁挂式电气柜门是否向外打开？
柜门是否达到并稳定保持在 45 度角？

original_en: Starting at 29.0 seconds, render only the visible aircraft fuselage as a bronze woodcut illustration with engraved linework over three seconds.
original_zh: 从第 29.0 秒开始，在三秒内仅将可见的飞机机身呈现为带雕刻线条的青铜色木刻插画。
atoms_en: Is the visible aircraft fuselage rendered as a bronze woodcut illustration with engraved linework?
Is the style change limited to the visible fuselage?
Is the style change completed within three seconds?
atoms_zh: 可见的飞机机身是否呈现为带雕刻线条的青铜色木刻插画？
风格变化是否仅限于可见机身？
风格变化是否在 3 秒内完成？

original_en: Starting at 26.0 seconds, change the wall-mounted gray electrical cabinet right of the aircraft to bright cobalt blue.
original_zh: 从第 26.0 秒开始，将飞机右侧壁挂的灰色电气柜变为明亮的钴蓝色。
atoms_en: Does the wall-mounted gray electrical cabinet right of the aircraft change to bright cobalt blue?
atoms_zh: 飞机右侧壁挂的灰色电气柜是否变为明亮的钴蓝色？

original_en: Starting at 14.0 seconds, make broad diagonal swells travel across the open water toward the work platform for five seconds.
original_zh: 从第 14.0 秒开始，让宽阔的斜向涌浪在开阔水面上朝作业平台传播五秒。
atoms_en: Do swells travel across the open water toward the work platform?
Are the swells broad and diagonal?
Does the travel continue for five seconds?
atoms_zh: 涌浪是否在开阔水面上朝作业平台传播？
涌浪是否宽阔且呈斜向？
传播是否持续 5 秒？

original_en: Starting at 29.0 seconds, change the curved platform railing from dark gray to matte cobalt blue over two and a half seconds.
original_zh: 从第 29.0 秒开始，在两点五秒内将弧形平台栏杆由深灰色变为哑光钴蓝色。
atoms_en: Does the curved platform railing change from dark gray to cobalt blue?
Does the changed railing have a matte finish?
Is the change completed within 2.5 seconds?
atoms_zh: 弧形平台栏杆是否由深灰色变为钴蓝色？
变化后的栏杆是否呈哑光效果？
这一变化是否在 2.5 秒内完成？

original_en: Starting at 27.0 seconds, make the pale platform deck visibly wet with a darker sheen and shallow reflective patches.
original_zh: 从第 27.0 秒开始，让浅色平台甲板变得明显湿润，并呈现更深的光泽和浅薄反光水斑。
atoms_en: Does the pale platform deck become visibly wet?
Does the deck develop a darker sheen?
Do shallow reflective patches appear on the deck?
atoms_zh: 浅色平台甲板是否变得明显湿润？
甲板是否呈现更深的光泽？
甲板上是否出现浅薄的反光水斑？

original_en: Starting at 14.0 seconds, lower the machine's front shutter until the remaining narrow opening along its lower edge is closed.
original_zh: 从第 14.0 秒开始，降下机器的前侧卷帘，直到其下缘剩余的狭窄开口完全闭合。
atoms_en: Does the machine's front shutter lower?
Does the remaining narrow opening along its lower edge close completely?
atoms_zh: 机器的前侧卷帘是否降下？
卷帘下缘剩余的狭窄开口是否完全闭合？

original_en: At 29.0 seconds, arrange the three gray bins in one evenly spaced row along the machine's left side.
original_zh: 在第 29.0 秒，将三个灰色箱体沿机器左侧排列成一排，并保持均匀间距。
atoms_en: Are all three gray bins arranged in one row along the machine's left side?
Are the bins evenly spaced?
atoms_zh: 三个灰色箱体是否全部沿机器左侧排列成一排？
箱体之间的间距是否均匀？

original_en: Starting at 27.0 seconds, change all three gray bins to matte dark green over two and a half seconds.
original_zh: 从第 27.0 秒开始，在两点五秒内将三个灰色箱体全部变为哑光深绿色。
atoms_en: Do all three gray bins change to dark green?
Do the changed bins have a matte finish?
Are the changes completed within 2.5 seconds?
atoms_zh: 三个灰色箱体是否全部变为深绿色？
变化后的箱体是否呈哑光效果？
这些变化是否在 2.5 秒内完成？

original_en: Starting at 17.0 seconds, move the camera along a lower clockwise arc around the wind turbine for four seconds.
original_zh: 从第 17.0 秒开始，让镜头围绕风力涡轮机沿较低的顺时针弧线移动四秒。
atoms_en: Does the camera move along a lower clockwise arc around the wind turbine?
Does the movement continue for four seconds?
atoms_zh: 镜头是否围绕风力涡轮机沿较低的顺时针弧线移动？
这一移动是否持续 4 秒？

original_en: Starting at 28.0 seconds, make the three visible grass bands beside the service roads bend and recover through two synchronized wind waves.
original_zh: 从第 28.0 秒开始，让维修道路旁三条可见草带经过两次同步风浪而弯曲并恢复。
atoms_en: Do all three visible grass bands beside the service roads bend and recover?
Do they move through exactly two wind waves?
Are the waves synchronized across the three grass bands?
atoms_zh: 维修道路旁三条可见草带是否都弯曲后恢复？
草带是否经过恰好两次风浪？
三条草带上的风浪是否同步？

original_en: Starting at 30.0 seconds, change the weather around the wind turbine to a moderate rain shower visible across the fields.
original_zh: 从第 30.0 秒开始，将风力涡轮机周围的天气变为中等阵雨，使降雨在田野上清晰可见。
atoms_en: Does the weather around the wind turbine change to a moderate rain shower?
Is the rain clearly visible across the fields?
atoms_zh: 风力涡轮机周围的天气是否变为中等阵雨？
降雨是否在田野上清晰可见？

original_en: Starting at 12.0 seconds, change the long wraparound curtains from muted taupe gray to matte deep teal over two and a half seconds.
original_zh: 从第 12.0 秒开始，在两点五秒内将长幅环绕窗帘由低饱和灰褐色变为哑光深青绿色。
atoms_en: Do the long wraparound curtains change from muted taupe gray to deep teal?
Do the changed curtains have a matte finish?
Is the change completed within 2.5 seconds?
atoms_zh: 长幅环绕窗帘是否由低饱和灰褐色变为深青绿色？
变化后的窗帘是否呈哑光效果？
这一变化是否在 2.5 秒内完成？

original_en: Starting at 29.0 seconds, accelerate the ongoing right-curtain opening until it is tightly gathered at the far-left side by 30.5 seconds.
original_zh: 从第 29.0 秒开始，加快右侧窗帘正在进行的打开过程，使其在第 30.5 秒前紧密收拢至最左侧。
atoms_en: Does the ongoing right-curtain opening accelerate?
Is the right curtain tightly gathered at the far-left side within 1.5 seconds?
atoms_zh: 右侧窗帘正在进行的打开过程是否加快？
右侧窗帘是否在 1.5 秒内紧密收拢至最左侧？

original_en: At 25.0 seconds, add a plain round cream rug at the center of the empty wooden floor.
original_zh: 在第 25.0 秒，在空置木地板中央添加一张简洁的圆形奶油色地毯。
atoms_en: Is a plain round cream rug added?
Is it positioned at the center of the empty wooden floor?
atoms_zh: 是否添加了一张简洁的圆形奶油色地毯？
该地毯是否位于空置木地板中央？

original_en: Starting at 13.0 seconds, increase the daylight through the left frosted window, brightening the sink and shower threshold over two and a half seconds.
original_zh: 从第 13.0 秒开始，在两点五秒内增强透过左侧磨砂窗的日光，并照亮水槽和淋浴间门槛。
atoms_en: Does the daylight through the left frosted window increase within 2.5 seconds?
Does the sink become brighter within the same 2.5 seconds?
Does the shower threshold become brighter within the same 2.5 seconds?
atoms_zh: 透过左侧磨砂窗的日光是否在 2.5 秒内增强？
水槽是否在同一段 2.5 秒内变亮？
淋浴间门槛是否在同一段 2.5 秒内变亮？

original_en: Starting at 29.0 seconds, open the right glass shower door outward until it reaches a stable halfway position.
original_zh: 从第 29.0 秒开始，将右侧玻璃淋浴门向外打开，直到达到稳定的半开位置。
atoms_en: Does the right glass shower door open outward?
Does it reach and remain at a stable halfway-open position?
atoms_zh: 右侧玻璃淋浴门是否向外打开？
淋浴门是否达到并稳定保持在半开位置？
